Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattiin buufataaleen kunneen seeraan alaa ta’uu isaanii beekamtii kennuun, ganda Israa’el kan seeraan beekamtii qabu irraa adda baasuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Biritishiin biyyoota dhihaa biroo waliin ta’uun tarkaanfii kana fudhachuun ishee, mirga ummanni Filisxeem ofiin of bulchuuf qabu deeggaruufi murtee Gamtaa Mootummootaa kabajchiisuuf kan gumaachudha.

title: Former New York Mayor Giuliani designated 'anti-Muslim extremist' by Muslim advocacy group
english: The Council on American-Islamic Relations has officially labeled former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani an anti-Muslim extremist due to his recent inflammatory remarks. During a television interview, Giuliani claimed that Muslims aim to dominate Western society and accused current Mayor Zohran Mamdani of supporting extremists. Muslim advocacy groups condemned these comments as hateful, while Mayor Mamdani chose to focus on honoring the victims of the 9/11 attacks rather than engaging with the criticism.
amharic: የአሜሪካ-እስላማዊ ግንኙነት ምክር ቤት የቀድሞውን የኒውዮርክ ከንቲባ ሩዲ ጁሊያኒ በሰጡት ጥላቻ የተሞላበት አስተያየት ምክንያት እንደ ጸረ-ሙስሊም ጽንፈኛ ፈርጇቸዋል። ጁሊያኒ በቴሌቪዥን ቃለ መጠይቅ ወቅት ሙስሊሞች በምዕራቡ ዓለም ላይ ለመጫን እንደሚሞክሩ በመናገር አሁን ላይ ያሉትን ከንቲባ ዞህራን ማምዳኒን ከሰዋል። የሙስሊም መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች ይህንን ንግግር ያወገዙ ሲሆን፣ ከንቲባ ማምዳኒ ግን ለትችቱ ምላሽ ከመስጠት ይልቅ የሴፕቴምበር 11 የሽብር ጥቃት ሰለባዎችን በማሰብ ላይ ማተኮርን መርጠዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan gorsaa fi walitti dhufeenya Islaamaa Ameerikaa (CAIR) kantiibaa magaalaa Niyoorki duraanii Rudii Jiliiyaaniin ibsa inni dhiyeenya kana kenne irratti hundaa'uun 'jibbiinsa Islaamaa babal'isaa' jechuun moggaaseera. Jiliiyaaniin gaaffii fi deebii televijiinii irratti, muslimoonni hawaasa lixaa to'achuuf akka yaalan dubbachuun, kantiibaa amma jiran Zohraan Maamdanii irratti yakka dhiyeesseera. Gareewwan mirga muslimootaa yaada kana balaaleffataniiru; gama biraatiin, kantiibaa Maamdanii xiinxala kanaaf deebii kennuu mannaa, miidhamtoota weerara seeteember 11 yaadachuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennuuf filataniiru.

title: IRGC says it targeted unmanned US sea drone in Hormuz
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps recently reported that its navy attempted to seize a solar-powered American surveillance drone in the Strait of Hormuz. This incident follows Iran's claim from the previous day that it had captured an underwater US drone, which American officials dismissed as a mechanical failure. These developments highlight ongoing maritime tensions in the region where the US Fifth Fleet utilizes such unmanned technology for data collection.
amharic: የኢራኑ እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘብ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ የአሜሪካ የባህር ላይ የስለላ ድሮን ለማስቆም እንደሞከረ አስታውቋል። ይህ ክስተት ኢራን ከአንድ ቀን በፊት ሌላ የአሜሪካ የባህር ውስጥ ድሮን መያዟን ከገለጸች በኋላ የመጣ ነው። የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ መግለጫ ግን የተያዘው ድሮን በቴክኒክ ችግር ምክንያት መሆኑን በመጥቀስ የኢራንን ክስ ውድቅ አድርጓል።
oromo: Waraanni Eegumsa Islaamummaa Iraan (IRGC), markaba hawaa irraa to'atamu kan Ameerikaa tokko naannoo Hormuzitti gargar baasuuf yaalii gochuu isaa beeksiseera. Kunis ta'e guyyaa tokko dura Iraan markaba bishaan jala deemu kan Ameerikaa qabachuu ishee erga beeksistee booda dha. Gama biraatiin, waraanni Ameerikaa markabni sun rakkoo tekinikaatiin akka bade ibsuun, ibsa Iraan sun sirrii akka hin taane beeksisaniiru.

title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
english: Houthi forces have gained control of the important Red Sea port city of Mokha following a week of intense fighting against pro-government troops. This advancement puts the group in a stronger position near the vital Bab al-Mandab shipping lane. Simultaneously, escalating tensions have led to Houthi missile strikes on Saudi oil facilities, further intensifying the long-standing conflict and impacting global energy markets.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ከሳዑዲ ለሚደገፈው የመንግስት ጦር ጋር ባደረጉት የአንድ ሳምንት ከፍተኛ ውጊያ የመክሃ ወደብን መቆጣጠራቸው ተገልጿል። ይህ ድርጊት ቡድኑን ለቀይ ባህር የንግድ መስመር ወሳኝ ወደሆነው የባብ አል-ማንዳብ ባህር ወሽመጥ ይበልጥ እንዲጠጉ አድርጓቸዋል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ በቡድኑ እና በሳዑዲ አረቢያ መካከል ያለው ውጥረት በማየሉ፣ በሳዑዲ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይ የተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ለዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ዋጋ መናር ምክንያት ሆነዋል።
oromo: Humnooni Huutii torban tokko guutuu waraana cimaa erga geggeessanii booda magaalaa buufata doonii istiraatejikii taate Mokhaa toannoo isaanii jala oolchaniiru. Gochi kun gareen kun karaa doonii gurguddaa kan ta'e handhuura Baab al-Maandaabitti dhihaachuuf gargaareera. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, wal dhabdeen Huutii fi Sa'udii gidduu jiru daran hammaatee, gareen kun buufataalee boba'aa Sa'udii irratti miidiilaan haleellaa geggeessuun gatiin boba'aa addunyaa akka ol ka'u taasiseera.

title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
english: A recent investigation into a fatal Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami revealed that one pilot repeatedly warned their colleague about excessive speed during the final approach. Despite these warnings and automated safety alerts about the aircraft's altitude and descent rate, the plane landed too fast and overshot the runway. The tragic accident resulted in five fatalities and several injuries, with authorities now examining why the cockpit crew did not successfully correct the plane's speed and landing configuration.
amharic: በማያሚ የተከሰከሰውን የአማዞን የጭነት አውሮፕላን አደጋ በመመርመር ላይ ያለው የዩኤስ የትራንስፖርት ደህንነት ቦርድ፣ አብራሪዎች አውሮፕላኑ በጣም ፈጣን መሆኑን እርስ በእርስ ሲያስታውሱ እንደነበር አስታውቋል። ምንም እንኳን አውቶማቲክ ማስጠንቀቂያዎች ቢሰሙም፣ አውሮፕላኑ ከመጠን ያለፈ ፍጥነት በመጓዝ ከመሮጫ መንገዱ አልፎ በመውጣቱ ለአምስት ሰዎች ህልፈት እና ለሌሎች ጉዳት ምክንያት ሆኗል። ባለሙያዎች አውሮፕላኑ ለማረፍ የሚያስፈልገውን ፍጥነት እና ዝግጅት በአግባቡ ማስተካከል ያልቻሉት ለምን እንደሆነ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaalaa Maayamiitti balaliirra ture xiyyaarri fe'umsaa kan Amazon erga kufuun booda qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, ogeeyyiin balalichaa xiyyaarichi saffisa baay'ee qabaachuu isaa wal akeekkachiisaa turan. Akeekkachiisni sirna itti-aansaan dhufuus, xiyyaarichi saffisaan qubatee daandii balaliirraa darbamee waan kuteef namoota shan ajjeeseera. Qorattoonni amma kan xiyyeeffatan xiyyaarichi maaliif akka saffisa isaa too'achuu fi sirnaan qubachuu dadhabe irratti dha.

title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is taking legal action against the newspaper Haaretz for reporting that he received a pre-attack warning from the UAE regarding Hamas's plans before October 7. Netanyahu’s office has firmly denied these allegations, labeling the report as a malicious conspiracy intended to undermine him. Meanwhile, the newspaper maintains the accuracy of its story, arguing that the lawsuit is an attempt to suppress independent journalism during a critical election period.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ጥቅምት 7 ቀን የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት በተመለከተ ከተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች ማስጠንቀቂያ ደርሷቸው ነበር የሚል ዘገባ ያሰራጨውን የሃሬትዝ ጋዜጣ ክስ ሊመሰርቱበት መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ቢሮ ይህ ዘገባ ፍጹም ሀሰት እና ስም ለማጥፋት የተጠነሰሰ ሴራ ነው በማለት ውድቅ አድርጎታል። ጋዜጣው በበኩሉ ዘገባው እውነተኛ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ የክስ ሂደት ጋዜጠኞችን ለማፈን የሚደረግ ሙከራ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamiin Netaanyaahuu, gabaasa gaazexaan Haaretz jedhamu, haleellaa Sadaasa 7 dura mootummaan UAE karoora Hamaas ilaalchisee akeekkachiisa isaaf kennuu isaa ibsu irratti himata seeraa banuuf karoorfate. Waajjirri Netaanyaahuu gabaasichi soba fi shirri isaan irratti xaxame akka ta'e dubbatee, gabaasicha guutummaatti haaleera. Gama biraatiin, gaazexaanichii gabaasichi dhugaa ta'uu isaa jabeessee ibsuun, himanni kun gaazexeessitoota ukkaamsuuf yaalii ta'uu isaa beeksisera.

title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
english: A tragic fire on a foreign cargo ship docked in the Chinese port of Qingdao has resulted in the deaths of 25 people. The vessel, which was undergoing maintenance, had 42 people on board at the time, with 17 individuals successfully evacuated. Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the blaze, while top government officials have called for intensive rescue and safety efforts.
amharic: በቻይና ቺንግዳኦ ወደብ በሚገኝ የውጭ አገር የጭነት መርከብ ላይ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ 25 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። መርከቧ ጥገና ላይ በነበረችበት ወቅት አደጋው ሲከሰት፣ በውስጧ ከነበሩት 42 ሰዎች መካከል 17ቱ በሕይወት መትረፍ ችለዋል። የቻይና ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማጣራት እና የነፍስ አድን ሥራዎችን ለማጠናከር ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Buufata doonii Chaayinaa Qingdao keessatti doonii fe'umsaa kan biyya alaa tokko irratti ibidda ka'een lubbuun namoota 25 darbeera. Yeroo ibiddayyu kun ka'u dooniin sun suphamaa kan turte yoo ta'u, namoota 42 irraa namoonni 17 qofa lubbuun oolaniiru. Qaamoleen mootummaa Chaayinaa sababa ibiddayyu kanaa qorachuufi hojii barbaachaafi baraarsa cimsanii itti fufuu akka qaban ibsaniiru.

title: US Supreme Court blocks Republican-drawn congressional map in Missouri
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has blocked a Republican-supported plan to redraw Missouri's congressional district maps, effectively requiring the state to use existing maps for the upcoming midterm elections. This decision follows a legal conflict where a state official faced contempt charges for ignoring local court orders regarding which map to follow. The ruling is a significant setback for efforts to shift electoral boundaries in favor of the Republican party.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት በሪፐብሊካኖች የተዘጋጀውን የሚዙሪ ግዛት የምርጫ ክልል ካርታ ውድቅ አድርጓል። በዚህም መሰረት ግዛቱ በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ላይ የነበሩትን ነባር ካርታዎች እንዲጠቀም ተወስኗል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የክልሉ ባለስልጣናት የፍርድ ቤቱን ትዕዛዝ ባለማክበር ክስ የቀረበባቸውን ግራ መጋባት ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Mana maree olaanaa Ameerikaa kaardii daangaa filannoo kan naannoo Mizuurii keessatti garee Ripablikanootaan qophaa'e akka hin hojii irra oolle dhoorkeera. Murtichi murtii kanaan dura kenname hordofee, filannoo dhufu irratti kaardii kanaan dura turetti akka fayyadaman dirqisiiseera. Haalli kun jeeqamsa bulchiinsa naannichaa fi murtiiwwan wal faallessan gidduutti kan uumame yoo ta'u, yaalii daangaa filannoo garee tokkoof mijatu akka hin milkoofne taasiseera.

title: Trump’s Iran war now has a midterm election problem
english: President Trump claims the seven-month conflict with Iran will resolve after the upcoming US midterm elections, accusing Tehran of trying to interfere with the vote. Despite aggressive military strikes and economic sanctions, Iran has refused to yield, causing political damage to Trump as domestic fuel prices and inflation continue to rise. This instability has negatively impacted Trump's approval ratings and worsened the cost of living for many Americans, potentially threatening his party's control of Congress.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ያለው የሰባት ወር ግጭት በቅርቡ በሚደረገው የአሜሪካ መካከለኛ ምርጫ እንደሚጠናቀቅ ገልጸው፣ ኢራን በምርጫው ላይ ተጽዕኖ ለማሳደር እየሞከረች ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል። ምንም እንኳን ጠንካራ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች እና የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች ቢኖሩም፣ ኢራን እጅ አልሰጠችም፤ ይህም በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እና የኑሮ ውድነት እንዲጨምር በማድረግ በትራምፕ የፖለቲካ ተቀባይነት ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ አሳድሯል። ይህ ሁኔታ ትራምፕ የኮንግረስን መቆጣጠሪያ እንዲያጡ ሊያደርግ እንደሚችል ተነግሯል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp waliin dhahuun Iraan waliin jiru kun filannoo giddu galeessa Ameerikaa booda akka xumaramu dubbatanii, Iraan filannicha irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf yaaltee jirti jechuun himatanii jiru. Tarkaanfiin waraanaa fi uggurri dinagdee cimaan fudhatames Iraan harka akka hin kennine kan taasise yoo ta'u, kunis gatii boba'aa fi gatii jireenyaa Ameerikaa keessatti akka dabalu taasiseera. Dhimmi kun beekamtii pireezidaantichaa gadi buusee fi to'annoo paarlaamaa garee isaa irratti balaa akka qabu ibsameera.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli strikes devastate Gaza
english: Israeli military air strikes have resulted in numerous deaths and injuries throughout the Gaza Strip. Meanwhile, the Israeli government has stated it has no plans to force Palestinians out of the region. Additionally, military operations and arrests are continuing to escalate across the occupied West Bank.
amharic: የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በጋዛ ሰርጥ በርካታ ሰዎችን ለህልፈትና ለጉዳት ዳርጓል። እስራኤል ፍልስጤማውያንን ከቀያቸው የማፈናቀል እቅድ እንደሌላት ብትገልጽም፣ በበኩሉ በተያዘው የምዕራብ ባንክ ግዛት ወታደራዊ ዘመቻዎች እና እስሮች ተባብሰዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gaazaa keessatti duula qilleensa irraa gaggeesseen lubbuun namoota hedduu darbee miidhaan guddaanis ga'eera. Gara biraatiin, Israa'el lammiilee Falasxiin biyyasaanii irraa ari'uuf akka hin qabne kan ibsite ta'us, naannoo daangaa dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti duulli waraanaa fi hidhaan itti fufee jira.

title: Oil jumps to $105, pushing up chances of a US interest rate increase
english: Oil prices have surged to over $105 per barrel due to intensifying attacks on shipping vessels and tankers in the Middle East. This sharp rise in fuel costs is fueling expectations that the United States may implement interest rate hikes to manage the resulting economic pressure. Market analysts are now concerned that the ongoing conflict will cause long-term supply disruptions, with the future stability of prices depending heavily on demand from China.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በተባባሰው የመርከቦች ጥቃት ሳቢያ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከአንድ በርሜል 105 ዶላር በላይ ከፍ ብሏል። ይህ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ አሜሪካ ሊመጣ የሚችለውን የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ለመቆጣጠር የወለድ ምጣኔን እንድትጨምር ሊያደርጋት እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች እየገለጹ ነው። እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት የነዳጅ አቅርቦትን ለረጅም ጊዜ ሊያውክ እንደሚችል ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ የወደፊቱ የዋጋ ሁኔታም በቻይና የነዳጅ ፍላጎት ላይ የተመሰረተ ይሆናል።
oromo: Hanga kahuu haleellaa dooniiwwan boba’aa fi dooniiwwan geejjibaa naannoo Baha Giddu galeessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun gatiin boba’aa barmeela tokko irratti gara doolaara 105 ol dabreera. Daballiin gatii boba’aa kun Ameerikaan dhiibbaa diinagdee uumamu to’achuuf jecha qooda qixxee dhala ykn riba (interest rate) dabaluu akka dandeessu abbootiin qabeenyaa hubachiisaniiru. Walitti bu’iinsi kun dhiyeessii boba’aa irratti gufuu yeroo dheeraa akka uumu kan sodaatamu yoo ta’u, gatiin boba’aa gara fuulduraa ammoo fedhii boba’aa Chaayinaan qabdu irratti kan hundaa’e ta’a.

title: LIVE: Manchester United vs Sabah – UEFA Champions League
english: Manchester United is hosting the club Sabah today at Old Trafford for a UEFA Champions League match. This league phase game is scheduled to begin at 8pm local time in Manchester. Fans are tuning in to watch the three-time tournament winners compete against their opponents.
amharic: ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ በኦልድ ትራፎርድ የዩኢኤፍኤ ቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ጨዋታውን ከሳባ ጋር ያደርጋል። ይህ የሊግ ምዕራፍ ጨዋታ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ማንቸስተር ምሽት 2 ሰዓት ላይ ይጀምራል። የውድድሩን ዋንጫ ሶስት ጊዜ ያነሳው ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ በሜዳው ተጋጣሚውን የሚገጥም ይሆናል።
oromo: Manchester United tapha UEFA Champions League tapha isa jalqabaa irratti garee Sabah waliin Old Trafford irratti taphata. Taphni kun magaalaa Manchesteritti halkan sa'aa 2:00 irratti kan eegalu ta'a. Gareen al sadii waancaa kana injifate Manchester United, taphataa isaa mooraa isaa keessatti kan keessummeessu ta'a.

title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
english: Donald Trump has promised that every American will receive $5,000 if his party succeeds in the upcoming midterm elections. However, the proposal faces significant scrutiny because he has not explained how it would be funded and critics have questioned its overall legality. Many opponents have dismissed the plan as an empty campaign promise, especially given the estimated $1.3 trillion price tag.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ በመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ካሸነፈ እያንዳንዱ አሜሪካዊ 5,000 ዶላር እንደሚቀበል ቃል ገብተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የዚህ እቅድ የገንዘብ ምንጭ ያልታወቀ በመሆኑ እና ህጋዊነት ላይ ጥያቄዎች በመነሳታቸው ጉዳዩ አወዛጋቢ ሆኗል። ተቃዋሚዎች ይህ ሀሳብ 1.3 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር ወጪ የሚጠይቅ በመሆኑ ትርጉም የለሽ የፖለቲካ ቃል መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Donald Traamp paartiin isaa filannoo dhufu irratti injifannoo yoo argate lammiileen Ameerikaa hundi doolaara 5,000 akka argatan waadaa galeera. Ta'us, karoora kanaaf maallaqni eessa akka dhufu waan hin ibsamneef akkasumas seera qabeessummaan isaa shakkamaa waan ta'eef falmii guddaa kaaseera. Morkattoonni karoori kun baasii doolaara tiriliyoona 1.3 kan gaafatu waan ta'eef, waadaa lafaa ka'u qofa akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
english: A power struggle has emerged in Uganda's Tooro Kingdom following the death of King Oyo, the world's youngest monarch, at age 34. Royal elders have appointed a 56-year-old television presenter as the successor, but the late king's family insists he left a will naming his young son as the heir. Amidst this dispute, the Queen Mother has reported that the family is being restricted by security forces and has pleaded for a peaceful burial for the late king.
amharic: የዓለማችን ወጣት ንጉሥ የነበሩት የቶሮው ንጉሥ ኦዮ በ34 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት መለየታቸውን ተከትሎ በዩጋንዳው የቶሮ መንግሥት የሥልጣን ሽኩቻ ተቀስቅሷል። የቤተ መንግሥቱ ሽማግሌዎች የቴሌቪዥን ጋዜጠኛ የሆኑትን ልዑል ኤድዋርድ ሩኪዲን ተተኪ አድርገው ቢሰይሙም፣ የሟቹ ቤተሰቦች ግን ንጉሡ በኑዛዜ ልጃቸውን እንደሰየሙ ይናገራሉ። ንግሥት እናቱ ቤተሰቦቻቸው በጦር ኃይሎች ተከበው እንደ ታሰሩ በመግለጽ፣ የልጇ የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓት በሰላም እንዲከናወን ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: mootummaa Tooro kan Yuugaandaa keessatti, mootichi dargaggeessi Oyo waggaa 34tti du'uusaanii hordofee wal dhabdee aangoo mudateera. Maanguddoonni gosaa gabaasaa televizhinii umriin isaanii 56 ta'e bakka buusuuf filatanis, maatiin mootichaa garuu inni ilma isaa akka inni mootii ta'u dhaalaan akka kaa'e dubbatu. Haati mootichaa, mootichi du'anii awwaalamuusaanii dura maatiin isaanii humnoota waraanaan ugguramuusaanii ibsuun, sirni awwaalchaa nagaan akka raawwatamu gaafataniiru.

title: Houthis advance along Yemen’s southern Red Sea coast
english: Houthi rebels supported by Iran are moving quickly across Yemen's southern Red Sea coastline. This military progress poses a significant threat to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which serves as a vital passage for global trade. Controlling this area would grant the group increased strategic influence over international shipping lanes.
amharic: በኢራን የሚደገፉት የሁቲ አማጽያን በየመን ቀይ ባህር ጠረፍ አካባቢ በፍጥነት እየገሰገሱ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ለአለም አቀፍ ንግድ እጅግ ወሳኝ በሆነው የባብ አል-ማንደብ የባህር መተላለፊያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። አካባቢውን መቆጣጠራቸውም አማጽያኑ በባህር መስመሮች ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ በእጅጉ እንዲጨምር ያደርገዋል።
oromo: Houthiwwan deeggarsa Iran argatan, qarqara galaana diimaa biyya Yemen keessatti ariitiin gadi bahuun bakkeewwan hedduu to'achaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun karaa daldala idil-addunyaa kan ta'e Bab el-Mandeb irratti balaa cimaa uumee jira. Houthiwwan bakka kana to'achuun isaanii dhiibbaa inni karaa galaanaa irratti qabu akka dabaluu danda'u himameera.

title: Manchester United scouted Mbappe but didn’t sign him, says Ryan Giggs
english: Former Manchester United coach Ryan Giggs revealed that the club had the opportunity to sign Kylian Mbappe when he was just a 15-year-old rising star at Monaco. After receiving a tip from a local scout in 2015, Giggs and his colleague watched the youngster and were deeply impressed by his talent. However, despite their recommendation, the club’s scouting department ultimately chose not to pursue a deal for the future superstar.
amharic: የቀድሞው የማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ አሰልጣኝ ሪያን ጊግስ ክለቡ በፈረንጆቹ 2015 በሞናኮ ይጫወት የነበረውን የ15 ዓመቱን ታዳጊ ኪሊያን ምባፔን የማስፈረም እድል እንደነበረው ገለጹ። ከፈረንሳይ በደረሳቸው ጥቆማ መሰረት ጊግስ እና ባልደረቦቹ ተጫዋቹን በአካል ተመልክተው በጣም እንደተደነቁ ተናግረዋል። ነገር ግን የክለቡ የስካውቲንግ ክፍል ጉዳዩን በመተው የወደፊቱን ኮከብ ለማስፈረም የሚያስችል እርምጃ ሳይወስድ ቀርቷል።
oromo: Leenjisaan duraanii Manchester United Ryan Giggs akka jedhetti, kilabichi Kylian Mbappe umriin isaa waggaa 15 turetti Monakootti yeroo taphatu isa fuudhuuf carraa akka qabaate ibseera. Bara 2015tti qorataa tokko irraa gorsa erga argatee booda, Giggs fi gargaartonni isaa dargaggeessa kana erga ilaalanii booda dandeettii isaa baay'ee dinqisiifataniiru. Ta'us, gorsi isaanii kun fudhatama argatee kilabichi dorgomaa guddaa ta'uuf deemu kana bituuf tarkaanfii fudhachuu hin dandeenye.

title: The Trump loyalty test: Will his supporters ever disagree with him?
english: Donald Trump is serving as the primary focus of the Republican Party's inaugural midterm convention. The event acts as a significant rallying point for party members looking to secure their control over Congress. The gathering highlights the strong influence Trump continues to wield over his supporters within the political movement.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ የመጀመሪያ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ስብሰባ ዋና ትኩረት ሆነው ቀርበዋል። ይህ ዝግጅት በኮንግረስ ውስጥ ያላቸውን የበላይነት ለማስጠበቅ ለሚጥሩ የፓርቲው አባላት ትልቅ የሞራል ድጋፍ ሰጪ መድረክ ሆኗል። ስብሰባው ትራምፕ በደጋፊዎቻቸው እና በፓርቲው እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ያላቸውን ከፍተኛ ተጽእኖ ያሳያል።
oromo: Donald Tiraampin walga'ii gidduu waggaa kan Paartii Rippaabilikaanotaa jalqabaa irratti xiyyeeffannaa guddaa argataniiru. Walga'iin kun miseensonni paartichaa mana maree keessatti aangoosaanii akka eeggatan jajjabeessuuf gargaara. Ta'iin kunis Tiraampin hordoftootasaanii fi sochii siyaasaa keessatti dhiibbaa guddaa qaban kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Hundreds of thousands lack adequate shelter at Sudan’s Tawila camp
english: Hundreds of thousands of displaced people at the Tawila camp in Sudan are facing a severe shelter crisis as aid remains insufficient to meet their needs. While some tents have been provided by international organizations, they fall far short of what is required to house the massive population currently threatened by the rainy season and potential famine. Local officials are calling for increased aid deliveries and improved border access to provide essential food and medicine to these struggling communities.
amharic: በሱዳን ታዊላ መጠለያ ካምፕ የሚገኙ በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተፈናቃዮች በቂ መጠለያ ባለማግኘታቸው ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ ድርጅቶች የድንኳን ድጋፍ ቢሰጡም፣ ያለው መጠለያ ለተፈናቃዮች ብዛት እጅግ አነስተኛ በመሆኑ ዝናባማው ወቅት እና የምግብ እጥረት ህይወታቸውን አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል። የክልሉ አስተዳደር ለተጎጂዎች የምግብ እና የመድኃኒት አቅርቦት እንዲጨምር እና የድንበር መግቢያዎች እንዲከፈቱ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Buufata Tawilaa kan sudaan keessatti argamu keessatti namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa’aman gargaarsa ga’aa fi iddoo jireenyaa dhabuun rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru. Dhaabbileen gargaarsaa dunkaana muraasa dhaabanis, lakkoofsi kun namoota kuma dhibbaan lakkaa’amaniif waan hin geenyeef, jiini roobaa fi hanqinni nyaataa lubbuu isaanii balaaf saaxilee jira. Hogganoonni naannichaa gargaarsi nyaataa fi qorichaa akka dabalu akkasumas karaaleen daangaa gargaarsaf akka banaman gaafataniiru.

title: At least 25 dead after cargo ship catches fire in China
english: A fire aboard a foreign-flagged cargo ship undergoing repairs at the Qingdao port in China has resulted in at least 25 deaths. Out of the 42 people on board, 12 were evacuated safely and five others are receiving hospital care. Chinese leadership has ordered a thorough investigation into the incident and emphasized the need for immediate search and rescue efforts.
amharic: ቻይና በሚገኘው የቺንግዳኦ ወደብ ለጥገና ቆሞ በነበረ የውጭ ሀገር የጭነት መርከብ ላይ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ 25 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በመርከቧ ላይ ከነበሩት 42 ሰዎች መካከል 12ቱ በሰላም ሲወጡ፣ አምስቱ ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው በህክምና ላይ ይገኛሉ። የቻይና ከፍተኛ አመራሮች በአደጋው ዙሪያ ጥልቅ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ እና የነፍስ አድን ስራው በአስቸኳይ እንዲቀጥል ትእዛዝ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Buufata doonii Qingdao kan Chaayinaa keessatti doonii fe'umsaa biyya alaa tokko kan suphamaa jirtu irratti ibidda ka'een lubbuun namoota 25 ol darbeera. Namoota 42 dooniittii keessa turan keessaa 12 nagaatti kan ba'an yoo ta'u, shan ammoo miidhaa irra ga'een hospitaala galanii yaalamaa jiru. Hooggantoonni Chaayinaa rakkoo kana irratti qorannoo cimaa akka taasisan fi hojiin barbaacha fi oolchuu namootaa ariitiin akka itti fufu ajajaniiru.

title: Trump says every adult American would get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
english: President Donald Trump has promised a $5,000 payment to every American adult if the Republican Party secures control of both houses of Congress in the upcoming midterms. While the plan aims to encourage voter turnout, critics have questioned its legal feasibility and the massive $1.3 trillion price tag. The proposal remains controversial, especially as the administration struggles with rising living costs and global oil supply issues linked to the ongoing conflict with Iran.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሪፐብሊካኖች በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ የኮንግረስ ቤቶችን ከተቆጣጠሩ፣ ለእያንዳንዱ አሜሪካዊ አዋቂ 5,000 ዶላር እንደሚሰጡ ቃል ገብተዋል። ይህ እቅድ የምርጫ ድምጽን ለመጨመር የታለመ ቢሆንም፣ የ1.3 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር ወጪ እንደሚጠይቅ በመጠቆም እና የህግ ተፈጻሚነቱን በመጠራጠር ተችቷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በአሜሪካ ያለው የኑሮ ውድነት እና ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ግጭት በነዳጅ ዋጋ ላይ እያደረሰ ባለው ተጽዕኖ ሳቢያ፣ ሃሳቡ ከፍተኛ ክርክር አስነስቷል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp, paartiin Riippabliikanii filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa dhufuun mana maree lameenuu to'annoo isaanii jala oolchuu yoo danda'an, lammiilee Ameerikaa hundaaf doolaara 5,000 kenna jedhanii waadaa galaniiru. Karoorri kun sagalee filannoo dabaluuf kan qophaaye ta'us, baasii tiriliyoona 1.3 gaafatuu fi seera qabeessummaa isaa irratti shakkiiwwan ka'aniiru. Haalli kun jireenya idilee irratti gatiin dabaluu fi waldhabdee Iraan waliin jiruun walqabatee gatiin boba'aa dabaluu isaa waliin walqabatee mormii guddaa kaasuu danda'eera.

title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
english: Donald Trump stated that the conflict with Iran will likely persist until the November midterm elections conclude. He claims that Iranian officials are holding out until then, hoping for a change in US leadership, and expects oil prices to drop once the situation is resolved. Despite his previous predictions of a short war, the ongoing instability has negatively impacted his approval ratings and caused domestic economic strain.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ጦርነት እስከ ህዳር ወር የአሜሪካ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ድረስ እንደሚቀጥል ተናግረዋል። የኢራን መንግስት በአሜሪካ የፖለቲካ ለውጥ እንደሚኖር በማሰብ ጦርነቱን እያራዘመ እንደሆነ እና ምርጫው እንዳለቀ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንደሚቀንስ ገልጸዋል። ምንም እንኳን ጦርነቱ በአጭር ጊዜ እንደሚጠናቀቅ ተስፋ ሰጥተው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የቆየው ውጥረት በፕሬዝዳንቱ ተወዳጅነት እና በሀገር ውስጥ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ አሉታዊ ተፅእኖ አሳድሯል።
oromo: Donald Trump walitti buiinsi Iran wajjin jiru hamma filannoo biyyoolessa Ameerikaa kan ji'a Sadaasaatti xumuramuutti kan itti fufu ta'uu ibseera. Mootummaan Iran jijjiirama siyaasaa Ameerikaa eeggachaa akka jiru fi filannoon erga darbee booda gatiin boba'aa akka hir'atu dubbateera. Walitti buiinsi kun yeroo gabaabaatti xumurama jedhee abdachaa kan ture ta'us, yeroo dheeraa fudhachuun isaa jaalatamummaa isaa fi diinagdee biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa uumeera.

title: Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on $2,000 first folding iPhone
english: Apple’s new CEO, John Ternus, has unveiled the company's first foldable smartphone, named the 'Duo,' marking the most significant design shift for the iPhone in two decades. This innovative device functions like a compact tablet when opened and a standard phone when folded, aiming to improve upon existing foldable market options. With a starting price of $1,999, it represents a bold and expensive new direction for the tech giant under its new leadership.
amharic: የአፕል አዲሱ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጆን ተርነስ ኩባንያው ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የፈጠረውን 'ዱኦ' የተሰኘ መታጠፊያ ስልክ አስተዋውቀዋል። ይህ መሳሪያ ሲከፈት እንደ ትንሽ ታብሌት የሚያገለግል ሲሆን፣ ሲታጠፍ ደግሞ እንደ ተለመደው ስልክ ያገለግላል። ስልኩ በገበያ ላይ ካሉ ሌሎች መታጠፊያ ስልኮች የተለየ እና የተሻሻለ ቅርፅ እንዳለው የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ዋጋውም ከ1,999 ዶላር ይጀምራል።
oromo: Hogganaan haaraan Apple John Ternus, bilbila Apple kan jalqabaa kan dachaatu 'Duo' jedhamu gadi dhiiseera. Meeshaan kun yeroo banamu akka taableetii xiqqaa kan hojjetu yoo ta'u, yeroo dachaatu immoo akka bilbila idilee tajaajila. Bilbilli kun kan biroo irraa adda ta'uuf kan qophaa'e yoo ta'u, gatiin isaa $1,999 irraa kan jalqabuufi jijjiirama guddaa Apple keessatti mul'ateedha.

title: ‘Gone in a blink’: Nepal floods sweep away Indian workers who built hotels
english: In late August, devastating flash floods in Syafrubesi, Nepal, destroyed the town and claimed the lives of numerous people, including migrant workers from India. While many residents and workers fled to higher ground as the water engulfed the area, thousands remain missing and over a thousand bodies have been recovered. Survivors who had spent years building the town's infrastructure watched helplessly as their work and homes were wiped away in moments.
amharic: በነሐሴ ወር መጨረሻ በኔፓል ስያፍሩቤሲ ከተማ የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ አደጋ መላውን ከተማ በማጥለቅለቅ በህንድ የመጡ ስደተኛ ሠራተኞችን ጨምሮ ብዙዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። አብዛኛው ነዋሪና ሠራተኛ ጎርፉ ሲመጣ ወደ ተራራማ ቦታዎች በመሸሽ ቢተርፉም፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች አሁንም የደረሱበት አልታወቀም፤ ከሺህ በላይ አስከሬኖችም ተገኝተዋል። ለዓመታት የከተማዋን መሠረተ ልማት ሲገነቡ የቆዩት በሕይወት የተረፉት ሰዎች፣ የለፉበት ሥራና ቤታቸው በአይን ጥቅሻ ሲጠፋ በዓይናቸው ማየት ችለዋል።
oromo: Dhuma ji'a Hagayyaatti magaalota Neepaali keessatti balaan lolaa tasaa uumame magaalattii guutummaatti barbadeesseera. Balaa kanaan hojjettoota godaantota Hindii irraa dhufan dabalatee namoonni hedduun lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Namoonni hedduun lolaa sana jalaa ooluuf gara tulluu yoo baqatanis, namoonni kumaatamaatti lakkaa'aman ammallee bakka bu'an hin beekamu; reeffi namoota kuma tokko ol ta'us argameera. Namoonni waggoota hedduuf guddina magaalattii irratti hojjechaa turan fi balaa kanaan oolanii hafne, manni fi ijaarsi isaan waggoota dheeraaf hojjetan yeroo gabaabaa keessatti lolaan hatamee yommuu deemu ilaaluun isaanii isaan miidheera.

title: Enrique hails Dembele, praises Toure after PSG’s win over Bratislava
english: Paris Saint-Germain started their Champions League campaign with a dominant 6-1 victory against Slovan Bratislava. Coach Luis Enrique praised Ousmane Dembele for his brilliant performance, which included two goals and two assists. Despite the heavy defeat, Enrique also commended Yaya Toure for his tactical approach as the first African coach to lead a team in this competition.
amharic: ፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜን በቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ውድድሩ ስሎቫን ብራቲስላቫን 6 ለ 1 በማሸነፍ ጉዞውን በድል ጀምሯል። አሰልጣኝ ሉዊስ ኤንሪኬ ሁለት ግቦችን ያስቆጠረውንና ሁለት የግብ እድሎችን የፈጠረውን ኦስማን ደምቤለን ብቃት አድንቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን የያያ ቱሬ ቡድን ቢሸነፍም፣ በውድድሩ የተሳተፈ የመጀመሪያው አፍሪካዊ አሰልጣኝ በመሆኑ ኤንሪኬ አክብሮታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Paaris Saint-Jeermeen injifannoo guddaa 6 fi 1 ta'een tapha Chaampiyoons Liigii isaa jalqabeera. Leenjisaan Paaris Luwiis Enrike taphataa Ousmane Dembele gahee inni tapha kana irratti taphateef jecha baay'ee galateeffataniiru. Tapha kana irratti garuu gareen Yayaa Tuuree mo'atamus, Enrike leenjisaa kana kan kabajaman yoo ta'u, inni leenjisaa Afrikaa isa jalqabaa dorgommii kana irratti garee leenjisu ta'uun isaa ibsameera.

title: Russian attacks kill 7 in Ukraine as Kyiv targets gas plants deep in Arctic
english: Russian strikes in Ukraine have resulted in the deaths of seven people across the Mykolaiv and Sumy regions, while wounding dozens more. In retaliation, Ukraine executed a long-range drone strike on an industrial facility in Russia's remote Arctic territory. This event marks one of the furthest reaching attacks conducted by Kyiv since the start of the conflict.
amharic: በዩክሬን በሚገኙ ሚኮላይቭ እና ሱሚ ክልሎች በተፈጸሙ የሩሲያ ጥቃቶች ሰባት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ለዚህ ምላሽ ዩክሬን በሩሲያ አርክቲክ ክልል ውስጥ በሚገኝ የኢንዱስትሪ ማዕከል ላይ የረጅም ርቀት ድሮን ጥቃት አድርሳለች። ይህ ጥቃት ኪየቭ ከጦርነቱ መጀመሪያ አንስቶ እስካሁን ካደረሰችው እጅግ ርቀት ያለው ጥቃት ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Humni Raashiyaa biyya Yukireen keessatti haleellaa geggeesseen namoonni torba ajjeefamanii, hedduun immoo madaa'aniiru. Kana booda, Yukireen mormii ishee ibsuuf naannoo Arktik kan Raashiyaa keessatti iddoo indastirii tokko irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) geggeessiteetti. Haleellaan kun, waraanni erga jalqabee asii asitti Yukireen iddoo fagoo akkanaa irratti haleellaa raawwatte keessaa isa tokko.

title: Israeli attacks kill at least four Palestinians in northern Gaza
english: Israeli military airstrikes in northern Gaza's Beit Lahiya town resulted in the deaths of a Palestinian couple and their two young daughters. These attacks occurred despite an ongoing ceasefire agreement that has been in place since October 2025. This incident is part of a broader conflict that has caused massive casualties and widespread destruction across the Gaza Strip.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ጋዛ ቤይት ላሂያ ከተማ በእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በተፈጸመ የቦምብ ጥቃት አንድ ጥንድ እና ሁለት ልጆቻቸው ተገድለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ከጥቅምት 2025 ጀምሮ በሥራ ላይ ባለው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ ቢሆንም የተፈጸመ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በጋዛ ሰርጥ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እና የሰዎች ህልፈት እያስከተለ ካለው ሰፊ ግጭት አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el kutaa kaaba Gaazaatti, magaalaa Beet Laahiyaatti weerara xiyyaaraan geggeesseen abbaa warraa fi haadha warraa akkasumas ijoollee isaanii lama ajjeeseera. Miidhaan kun kan raawwatame, waligalteen dhaabbii waraanaa baatii Onkololeessa 2025 irraa eegalee ture jiraatusi. Kuni hunda dabalatee, waraana Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbaa jiraachuu fi miidhaan guddaan geessifamaa jiraachuu agarsiisa.

title: Japan baseball great and atomic bomb survivor Isao Harimoto dies aged 86
english: Japanese baseball icon Isao Harimoto has passed away at the age of 86. A survivor of the Hiroshima atomic bombing, he overcame a childhood injury to become the all-time hits leader in Japanese professional baseball. Inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame in 1990, he remains remembered for his incredible skill and storied 23-season career.
amharic: የጃፓን የቤዝቦል ኮከብ ኢሳኦ ሃሪሞቶ በ86 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። የሂሮሺማ የኒውክሌር ቦምብ ጥቃት የተረፉት ሃሪሞቶ፣ በልጅነታቸው በደረሰባቸው ጉዳት አልበገሩም እና በጃፓን ቤዝቦል ታሪክ ከፍተኛውን የኳስ መምታት ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግበዋል። እ.ኤ.አ. በ1990 ወደ ቤዝቦል ዝነኞች አዳራሽ የገቡት አትሌቱ፣ ለ23 ዓመታት በቆየው የሙያ ህይወታቸው ትልቅ አድናቆት ነበራቸው።
oromo: Leencichi ispoortii beysbolii Jaappaan Isao Harimoto waggaa 86tti lubbuun darbeera. Miidhaa roobii atoomikii Hiroshiimaa irraa kan oole namichi kun, miidhaa ijoollummaatti irra ga'e hunda dandamatee seenaa beysbolii Jaappaan keessatti rekodii olaanaa galmeessiseera. Bara 1990 galmee kabajaa beysbolii (Hall of Fame) keessatti kan galmaa'e yoo ta'u, hojii isaa waggaa 23 keessatti sadarkaa beekamtii guddaa argateera.

title: Family of four killed in Israeli strike in northern Gaza
english: An Israeli military airstrike in northern Gaza resulted in the deaths of a family of four, including two children aged eight and twelve. Local medical officials confirmed that the tragedy occurred after the attack struck their home in the Beit Lahia area. The victims' remains were recovered by rescue workers shortly after the incident.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ጋዛ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት የሁለት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ የአንድ ቤተሰብ አራት አባላት ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ የቤይት ላሂያ አካባቢ በሚገኝ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ ያነጣጠረ መሆኑን የህክምና ባለሙያዎች አረጋግጠዋል። በደረሰው ጥቃት የ12 እና የ8 ዓመት ህጻናት ህይወት ማለፉም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gammoojjii gaazaatti miilaan rukutamee namoota afur, kanneen keessaa ijoollee lama dabalatee, ajjeeseera. Ogeeyyonni fayyaa akka ibsanitti, rukutaan kun mana jireenyaa naannoo Beit Lahia keessatti argamu irratti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, ijoolleen lubbuun isaanii darbe umurii isaanii waggaa 12 fi 8 akka ta'e beekameera.

title: Ali al-Taher: What Israel’s 'operational control' of the hill really means for Hezbollah and Lebanon
english: The Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon has become a key strategic point of contention between Hezbollah and Israeli forces. Unlike its usual guerrilla tactics of avoiding fixed positions, Hezbollah initially treated this hill as a vital location to be defended due to its underground facilities and tactical command over the region. Losing control of this ridge allows Israel to monitor Nabatieh and Iqlim al-Tuffah, effectively reversing the area's power dynamics and surveillance capabilities.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚገኘው የአሊ አል-ታሄር ኮረብታ በሂዝቦላህ እና በእስራኤል ኃይሎች መካከል ትልቅ ስትራቴጂያዊ የጦርነት ነጥብ ሆኗል። ሂዝቦላህ ከተለመደው የረቀቀ የጦር ስልቱ በተለየ መልኩ፣ ይህንን ስፍራ ከመሬት በታች ባሉት ወታደራዊ መሠረተ ልማቶች ምክንያት ለመከላከል ወስኖ ነበር። የእስራኤል ጦር የዚህን ስፍራ ቁጥጥር መያዙ በናባቲህ እና በአካባቢው ላይ የክትትል የበላይነት እንዲኖራት በማስቻል፣ የጦርነቱን ሚዛን ለሂዝቦላህ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Gaarreen Ali al-Taher jedhamu kan kibba Libaanos argamu, humnoota Hizbollah fi Israa'el gidduutti dirree waraanaaf bakka murteessaa ta'eera. Hizbollah, iddoo dhaabbataa qabachuu irraa of qusachuun baratamaa ta'us, gaarreen kun bakka buufataalee jala-lafaa qabuuf jecha akka bakka itti gaafatamuutti ilaale. Israa'el gaarree kana to'achuun ishee, naannoo Nabatieh fi Iqlim al-Tuffah irratti hordoffii cimaa akka taasiftuufi humna waraanaa ishee akka jabeessitu gargaareera.

title: Settlement trade ban: Burnham succeeds in weeks where Starmer failed for years
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has introduced a ban on trade with Israeli settlements, marking a significant shift in foreign policy just seven weeks into his term. This move aligns Britain with the 2024 International Court of Justice ruling regarding the illegality of the settlements, highlighting a contrast with the inaction of his predecessor, Keir Starmer. Meanwhile, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch faces criticism for siding with Israel against this policy, a stance that has sparked a major political divide.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ስልጣን ከያዙ ሰባት ሳምንታት በኋላ በእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ላይ የንግድ እገዳ ጥለዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የ2024ቱን የዓለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ በመከተል ብሪታንያ የቀድሞውን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኬይር ስታርመርን አቋም በመቀየር ከዓለም አቀፍ ህግ ጋር እንድትጣጣም ያደርጋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ የተቃዋሚው መሪ ኬሚ ቤደኖክ ይህንን ውሳኔ በመቃወም ከእስራኤል ጎን መቆማቸው በብሪታንያ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ትልቅ መከፋፈል ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Biritaniyaa Andy Burnham erga aangoo qabatanii torban torba booda, daldala naannawaa Israa'elitti argaman irratti dhorkaa kaa'aniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun murtee Mana Murtii Addunyaa bara 2024 kan naannawaan sun seeraan ala ta'uu ibsu waliin kan wal simatu yoo ta'u, mootummaa kanaan duraa kan Keir Starmer irraa adda baasa. Gama biraatiin, hogganaan mormituu Kemi Badenoch tarkaanfii mootummaa kana mormuudhaan Israa'el gargaaruun isaanii siyaasa Biritaniyaa keessatti walitti bu'iinsa guddaa uumeera.

title: In Syria's Daraa, water is life - and today the land is parched
english: Lake al-Muzayrib in southern Syria, once a vital water source for agriculture and fishing, has completely dried up due to prolonged drought and poor resource management. Former fisherman Abdul-Munaf al-Masri and his community have suffered greatly, losing their livelihoods as the region faces an unprecedented water collapse. This environmental disaster has forced many local workers to abandon their traditional way of life and find new jobs just to survive.
amharic: በደቡብ ሶሪያ የሚገኘው የአል-ሙዛይሪብ ሐይወት በረጅም ጊዜ ድርቅ እና በውኃ ሀብት አያያዝ ጉድለት ምክንያት ሙሉ በሙሉ ደርቋል። ቀደም ሲል በአካባቢው የነበሩ አሳ አጥማጆች እንደ አብዱል-ሙናፍ አል-ማስሪ ያሉት ሰዎች የኑሮ ምንጫቸውን በማጣታቸው ለከፍተኛ ችግር ተጋልጠዋል። ይህ አስከፊ የውኃ እጥረት በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ የነበረውን ባህላዊ የኑሮ ዘይቤ በማስተጓጎል፣ ብዙዎች ለህልውና ሲሉ ወደ ሌላ ሥራ ለመሰማራት ተገደዋል።
oromo: Haroon Al-Muzayrib kan kibba Suuriyaatti argamu, sababa hongee yeroo dheeraa fi itti fayyadama bishaanirratti hanqina jiruun guutummaatti gogee jira. Qonnonni fi qurxummii qabattoonni naannichaa akka Abdul-Munaf al-Masri fa'i, madda galii isaanii waan dhabaniif miidhaan cimaan irra ga'ee jira. Balaan kun jiraattota naannichaa jireenya isaanii isa kanaan duraa akka dhiisan fi akka jiraataniif gara hojii biraatti akka seenan isaan dirqisiisee jira.

title: Pakistan, Turkey back Arab endorsement of UK's settlement sanctions
english: Pakistan and Turkey have officially expressed their support for an Arab-led statement that endorses the United Kingdom’s decision to sanction products from illegal Israeli settlements. During a phone call, the foreign ministers of both nations discussed regional stability and reaffirmed their commitment to ongoing cooperation with Saudi Arabia and Egypt. Additionally, Pakistan's defense minister highlighted that a mutual defense agreement could be triggered if Saudi Arabia faces further military threats.
amharic: ፓኪስታን እና ቱርክ፣ ብሪታኒያ በሕገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ምርቶች ላይ የጣለችውን ማዕቀብ የሚደግፍ የአረብ አገራት የጋራ መግለጫ መደገፋቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሁለቱ አገራት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በስልክ ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ በቀጠናዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ ያላቸውን ትብብር አጠናክረው ለመቀጠል ተስማምተዋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ የፓኪስታን የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የተፈረመው የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተግባራዊ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Paakistaaniifi Turkii murtoo Biriiteen sochii naannoo Israa'el seeraan alaa ta'e irratti uggura kaa'uuf fudhatte kan deggeran ta'uusaanii ibsaniiru. Ministiroonni dhimmi alaa biyyoota lamaanii bilbiladhaan haasa'anii, nageenya naannichaa eeguufi biyyoota akka Sa'udii Arabiyaafi Masri wajjin walta'iinsasaanii cimsuuf waliigalaniiru. Kana malees, ministirri ittisa biyyaa Paakistaan, yoo Sa'udii Arabiyaa irratti weerarri raawwatame, waligalteen ittisaa isaan gidduutti mallatteeffame hojiirra ooluu akka danda'u ibsaniiru.

title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry
english: A passenger ferry traveling to the Philippine tourist destination of Coron caught fire on Wednesday evening, resulting in at least five deaths. Authorities are currently searching for 86 missing individuals, while 43 survivors have been rescued and taken to a nearby facility. Rescue operations are being severely hampered by dangerous weather conditions and strong sea currents that have caused the burning vessel to drift.
amharic: ወደ ፊሊፒንስ የቱሪስት መዳረሻ ኮሮን ሲጓዝ የነበረ የመንገደኞች መርከብ ረቡዕ ምሽት በእሳት መያዙን ተከትሎ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ባለሥልጣናት አሁንም 86 የጠፉ ሰዎችን እየፈለጉ ሲሆን 43 ሰዎች ታድገው ወደ ተዘጋጀላቸው መጠለያ ተወስደዋል። የነፍስ አድን ስራው በከባድ የአየር ሁኔታ እና መርከቧን ወደ ሌላ አቅጣጫ እየወሰደ ባለው ኃይለኛ የባህር ሞገድ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ችግር ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Dooniin abbaa manaa gara kutaa Filippiin kan taate Coron deemaa turte tokko roobii galgala ibiddan gubattee namoonni shan lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Aangoonni mootummaa namoota 86 bakka buuteen isaanii hin beekamne barbaacha irratti kan argaman yoo ta'u, namoonni 43 lubbuun baraarramanii gara bakka nageenyaa geeffamaniiru. Hojiin fayyinsaa haala qilleensa hamaa fi dhangala'aa bishaan galaanaa cimaa doonittiin akka naanna'u godheen gufata guddaa keessa galeera.

title: Five dead, dozens missing in Philippines ferry fire
english: A passenger ferry named M/V June Aster caught fire while traveling near the coast of Palawan in the Philippines, leaving at least five people dead. Rescuers have safely recovered over 40 individuals, but authorities report that 87 people are still missing. Search and rescue operations are currently underway to locate the remaining passengers and crew members from the vessel.
amharic: ኤም/ቪ ጁን አስቴር የተባለ የሳቢ ተሳፋሪ መርከብ በፊሊፒንስ ፓላዋን ጠረፍ አቅራቢያ በእሳት በመያዙ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ከ40 በላይ ሰዎችን ማዳን ቢችሉም፣ እስካሁን 87 ሰዎች የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። የጠፋውን ሰው ለማግኘት የፍለጋ እና የማዳን ስራዎች በአሁኑ ሰዓት በስፋት እየተካሄዱ ነው።
oromo: Markabii imaltootaa 'M/V June Aster' jedhamu kan biyya Filippiins naannoo Palawaanitti ibiddi qabatee, namoonni shan lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Humnoonni fayyisaa namoota 40 ol olchuuf kan danda'an ta'us, namoonni 87 ammallee eessa akka jiran hin beekamne. Hojiiwwan barbaachaafi fayyisaa namoota hafan argachuuf ammayyuu itti fufee jira.

title: Netanyahu to sue Haaretz over claims UAE warned him before October 7 attack
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is launching a lawsuit against the Haaretz newspaper following a report that claimed the UAE president warned him about the October 7, 2023, Hamas attack. Netanyahu dismissed the allegations as completely false and fabricated, stating he never received such a warning. The newspaper had alleged that UAE leader Mohammed bin Zayed contacted Netanyahu regarding intelligence about an impending threat, but the Prime Minister insists this account is untrue.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ፣ የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬትስ ከጥቅምት 7 ቀን 2023 የሃማስ ጥቃት አስቀድሞ አስጠንቅቀዋቸው እንደነበር የዘገበውን 'ሃአሬትዝ' የተባለውን ጋዜጣ ክስ ሊመሰርቱበት መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ኔታንያሁ ዘገባው ፍጹም ሐሰት እና የተፈጠረ ነው በማለት ያስተባበሉ ሲሆን፣ የሕግ ባለሙያዎቻቸውም በጋዜጣው ላይ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ አዘዋል። ጋዜጣው የኤምሬትሱ መሪ መሐመድ ቢን ዛይድ ስለ ጥቃቱ ለጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ በስልክ ነግረዋቸው እንደነበር ቢገልጽም፣ ኔታንያሁ ግን ይህንን ወሬ አጣጥለውታል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Nataanyaahuu, gabaasa gaazexaan Haarets jedhamu, pirezidaantiin UAE qophii haleellaa Hagayya 7, 2023 dura akeekkachiisa kennanii turan jechuun baase irratti himata banuuf akka qophaa'e ibsaniiru. Nataanyaahuun gabaasichi sobaafi namni ofiin kan uumeedha jedhanii kan morman yoo ta'u, abbootii seeraa isaaniis gaazexicha irratti tarkaanfii akka fudhatan ajajaniiru. Gaazexaan kun, hogganaan UAE Mohaammad biin Zaayed haleellaa dhufaa jiru ilaalchisee Nataanyaahuu gorsanii turan jedhee gabaasuus, mummichi ministeerichaa dubbiin kun dhugaa miti jechuun haalaniiru.

title: Why is Iran bombing Jordan’s Al-Azraq base?
english: Iran has recently intensified military strikes against the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base located near Al-Azraq, Jordan. Tehran considers this facility a primary target because it serves as a critical operational center for United States military forces in the region. These attacks reflect ongoing regional tensions and Iran's strategic efforts to challenge the American military presence.
amharic: ኢራን በቅርቡ በዮርዳኖስ አል-አዝራቅ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው ሙዋፋቅ ሳልቲ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃቷን አጠናክራለች። ቴህራን ይህንን ጣቢያ የአሜሪካ ጦር በክልሉ የሚጠቀምበት ዋና የኦፕሬሽን ማዕከል እንደመሆኑ መጠን ትክክለኛ ኢላማ አድርጋ ትመለከተዋለች። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የክልሉን ውጥረት እና ኢራን በአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ መገኘት ላይ ያላትን ተቃውሞ የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Iraan dhiheenya kana buufata xiyyaraa Muwaffaq Salti kan Al-Azraq, Yordaanositti argamu irratti haleellaa cimaa gaggeessaa jirti. Tehraan buufatni kun giddugala waraana Ameerikaa waan ta'eef, akka kaayyoo haleellaa isaatti ilaalatti. Haleellaan kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, Iraan hirmaannaa waraana Ameerikaa naannichaa mormuuf yaalii gochaa jirtuudha.

title: Trump vows to be at centre of US midterms: Republican convention takeaways
english: President Donald Trump took center stage at a unique Republican midterm convention, urging voters to treat him as if he were on the ballot despite his name not being up for election. He pledged to personally campaign across the country to help Republicans retain control of Congress, even as some party members worry his active involvement could alienate voters. The strategy aims to overcome historical trends where sitting presidents often see their party struggle in midterm contests.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በተካሄደው ልዩ የሪፐብሊካን መካከለኛ ምርጫ ጉባኤ ላይ ዋናውን ሚና በመውሰድ፣ ስማቸው በምርጫ ካርድ ላይ ባይኖርም መራጮች እሳቸው እንዳሉ እንዲቆጥሩ ጠይቀዋል። የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ በኮንግረስ ያለውን የበላይነት እንዲጠብቅ ለማድረግ በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ በንቃት እንደሚንቀሳቀሱ ቃል ገብተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ አንዳንድ የፓርቲው አባላት የእሳቸው ጣልቃ ገብነት ተቃዋሚዎችን በማነሳሳት ምርጫውን ሊጎዳ ይችላል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp yaa'ii addaa koraa giddu-galeessa waggaa (midterm) Rippabilikaanotaa irratti hirmaachuun, maqaan isaanii kan hin jirre ta'us akka waan isaan filannoo irratti dorgomaa jiranitti akka ilaalaman gaafataniiru. Rippabilikaanonnii to'annoo Kongiresii akka hin dhabneef biyyattii keessa naanna'uun duuluuf waadaa galaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, hirmaannaan isaanii kun warra ka biroo kan mufachiisuu danda'u ta'uu isaa hoggantoonni tokko tokko ni yaaddahu.
